newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg to launch Honey Crunch Corn Flakes.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg to launch Honey Crunch Corn Flakes.

text.p: Kellogg Co said Thursday it was introducing Honey Crunch Corn Flakes and would support the cereal with a marketing campaign that includes advertising, promotion and public relations.

The new product will be available in 15.1 ounce and 21.3 ounce sizes in U.S. supermarkets by mid-October. Prices are determined by retailers, but special introductory prices will be offered, Kellogg said.
A national television advertising campaign will break in October, handled by WPP Group Plc's J. Walter Thompson agency in New York.
As part of its promotion, the new cereal will be a sponsor of a NASCAR race car.
